scripts.dev: concurrently --names sim,api,worker,web --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow,magenta --restart-tries -1 --restart-after 1000 "pnpm dev:sim" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: ROLE=api uv --directory apps/backend run python -m app
scripts.dev:worker: ROLE=worker uv --directory apps/backend run python -m app
scripts.lint: uv --directory apps/backend run ruff check && uv --directory apps/backend run ruff format --check && uv --directory apps/backend run ty check src tests && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
